Answer B is stronger on content from the groomer's world, such as plan names, trade terms and testimonials, and it gives a clear top-three priority list. However, B is mostly a list of nine tips and only touches on focal point and hierarchy. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B better explains why the page feels generic: every element is emphasized, so the eye has no order to follow, and equal cards tell the reader every feature matters equally. A is the only one with a clear order of what to change first, its 'If you only do three things' list, while B gives no order.
